episode.title: Make context-compaction and branch-summary requests resilient to transient stream failures
episode.before: At parent 4b91ec66fd33026e6e44a0dca5a954a59abd3ee9, generated compaction summaries, split-turn prefix summaries, and branch summaries issued one model completion request. A transient retryable response such as stopReason="error" with errorMessage="terminated" immediately failed the structural session operation, even though agent-turn requests already had configurable retry settings. Retry backoff cancellation and summarization-specific retry lifecycle reporting were absent.
episode.after: At 65dd2e0ed6c71bd61d698353c29f2de24968bf76, all generated compaction and branch-summary model calls can use the configured bounded retry policy. A shared helper retries only errors accepted by the existing transient-error classifier, applies exponential backoff, stops at maxRetries, fails fast for deterministic errors, and converts an abort during backoff into an aborted assistant response. Session and harness adapters pass retry policy and abort signals into summarization, emit retry lifecycle events, and allow the interactive UI and external consumers to observe retry scheduling, attempt restart, and completion.
episode.diff: The merge adds reusable RetryPolicy, RetryCallbacks, abortable backoff, and retryAssistantCall in the AI utility layer; routes compaction history summaries, split-turn prefix summaries, and branch summaries through that retry boundary in both agent-harness and coding-agent implementations; supplies settings.retry from manual compaction, automatic compaction, and tree-navigation call sites; introduces typed retry lifecycle events and interactive status handling; and adds unit, harness, and issue-regression tests covering recovery, retry exhaustion, disabled policy, non-retryable errors, callback ordering, and abort during backoff.

evidence_units.claim: Pinned merge commit 65dd2e0ed6c71bd61d698353c29f2de24968bf76 has first parent 4b91ec66fd33026e6e44a0dca5a954a59abd3ee9 and states that compaction and branch summarization follow retry policy.

The AI utility layer defines a retry policy and callbacks, then implements a bounded loop that classifies retryable assistant errors, computes exponential delays, supports abortable backoff, and reports success, exhaustion, or abort.
Before the change, agent-harness compaction history summaries, split-turn prefix summaries, and branch summaries called Models.completeSimple directly without a retry policy.

Agent-harness adds completeSimpleWithRetries and routes ordinary compaction summaries, split-turn prefix summaries, and branch summaries through it while propagating retry policy, callbacks, and the operation abort signal.

Coding-agent exports completeSummarization as the common completion boundary and wraps either the configured stream function or the simple completion function with retryAssistantCall; all compaction summary variants pass retry policy and callbacks through this boundary.

Manual compaction and automatic threshold/overflow compaction obtain the configured retry settings and pass operation-specific callbacks and the existing compaction abort signal into summary generation.

Default branch summarization during tree navigation receives the configured retry settings, branch-summary retry callbacks, and the existing branch-summary abort signal; extension-provided summaries bypass model generation.

Coding-agent maps retry callbacks to typed summarization_retry_scheduled, summarization_retry_attempt_start, and summarization_retry_finished events, preserving compaction reason or branch-summary source for consumers.
Agent-harness accepts an optional retry policy, emits operation-tagged retry lifecycle events, and supplies those callbacks to generated compaction and branch-summary operations.

Retry utility tests specify immediate success, no retry for abort or quota errors, disabled-policy behavior, bounded exhaustion, recovery before exhaustion, callback ordering, and aborting a pending backoff.

Harness tests specify successful recovery of compaction and branch-summary operations, no retry for non-retryable errors, exhaustion at the configured budget, and operation-tagged retry event sequences.

The issue regression test reproduces transient mid-stream "terminated" failures and specifies that compaction succeeds after retries, fails fast for quota or disabled retry, stops after maxRetries, and can abort a long backoff.
Interactive mode displays the transient error and retry countdown, restores the branch-summary or compaction status when a retry attempt starts, and clears retry status when the loop finishes.

The committed regression oracle expects three model calls for two transient failures followed by success, one call for non-retryable or disabled cases, three calls for maxRetries=2 exhaustion, and an aborted compaction when cancellation interrupts backoff.

The implementation change is behavior-bearing rather than documentation-only: the first-parent diff changes retry utilities, both summarization implementations, session/harness call sites, event contracts, UI handling, and tests.

candidate_atomics.name: retry_transient_summary_request
candidate_atomics.title: Retry a transient summary request within a bounded budget
candidate_atomics.description: Wrap one assistant-producing summary request with retry classification, exponential backoff, a fixed retry budget, abort-aware waiting, and lifecycle callbacks.

semantic_action.intent: Allow a context-preserving summary operation to survive temporary transport or provider failures without retrying deterministic failures indefinitely.
semantic_action.pre_state: A summary request has returned an assistant error response, and an optional retry policy and abort signal are available.
semantic_action.post_state: The request either succeeds within the configured retry budget, returns the final classified error without exceeding the budget, or returns an aborted response when cancellation occurs; quota-like and other non-retryable failures are not repeated.
semantic_action.validation: Use a scripted producer to assert one call on success, abort, disabled policy, and non-retryable errors; initial-call-plus-maxRetries calls on exhaustion; early termination on recovery; ordered lifecycle callbacks; and cancellation of an in-progress backoff.
parameters: error classifier: transient versus terminal assistant error

candidate_atomics.name: route_context_summaries_through_retry_policy
candidate_atomics.title: Apply the retry policy to every generated context summary
candidate_atomics.description: Propagate the existing retry configuration, cancellation signal, and callbacks through manual compaction, automatic compaction, split-turn prefix summarization, and branch summarization so all generated context summaries share the same resilience boundary.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent a single transient stream drop from aborting context compaction or branch preservation while keeping extension-supplied summaries outside the model retry path.
semantic_action.pre_state: Context compaction or branch navigation requires a generated model summary, but summary call paths either invoke the provider once or do not receive the runtime retry policy.
semantic_action.post_state: Every model-generated history, split-turn prefix, and branch summary runs through the bounded retry helper with the operation's existing abort signal and configured retry settings; summaries supplied by hooks or extensions remain direct inputs.
semantic_action.validation: Script transient errors followed by success at manual/automatic compaction and branch-summary entry points, then assert the operation completes with the recovered summary; separately assert deterministic failure, disabled policy, exhaustion, and abort behavior.

candidate_atomics.name: publish_summary_retry_lifecycle
candidate_atomics.title: Publish summary retry lifecycle state to callers
candidate_atomics.description: Translate retry callbacks into typed operation-aware events and update the interactive status so retries are observable and cancellable operations do not appear stalled.

semantic_action.intent: Make delayed or repeated context-summary requests visible to harness subscribers, external integrations, and the interactive user interface.
semantic_action.pre_state: A generated summary request may enter backoff and retry, but consumers only observe the surrounding compaction or navigation operation.
semantic_action.post_state: Consumers receive scheduled, attempt-start, and finished lifecycle events with retry counts, delays, errors, and operation context; the interactive interface transitions between retry and underlying operation indicators.
semantic_action.validation: Subscribe to lifecycle events and assert scheduled/start/finished ordering and operation labels during recovery and exhaustion; verify no retry events for deterministic errors; exercise UI event branches for retry countdown, operation restoration, and cleanup.

candidate_workflows.name: harden_context_summary_generation
candidate_workflows.title: Harden context-summary generation against transient request failures
candidate_workflows.description: A partial-order workflow for adding bounded, abortable retry behavior to context-compaction and branch-summary requests while preserving deterministic failure behavior, supplied-summary bypasses, and observable operation state.

workflow_graph.goal: Generated context summaries recover from temporary provider or transport failures within a configured budget without masking terminal failures or making operation state opaque.
when_to_use: A context compaction, truncation, checkpoint, or branch-preservation operation depends on a model-generated summary.
A transient stream or transport failure currently aborts the entire structural context operation on its first failed request.
The runtime already has, or can accept, a bounded retry policy and an operation cancellation signal.
anti_goals: Do not retry context-overflow, quota, billing, authentication, or other errors rejected by the transient-error classifier.
Do not create an unbounded retry loop or silently ignore the configured retry budget.
Do not retry summaries supplied by hooks, extensions, caches, or callers when no model request is made.
Do not change summary selection, token budgeting, retained-tail boundaries, prompts, or persistence semantics merely to add request resilience.
not_applicable_when: The failure is caused by deterministic summary preparation, invalid session structure, or an unusable context boundary rather than a transient assistant request error.
The operation has no model-generated summary request.
The system cannot classify failed assistant responses or cannot cancel a pending retry delay safely.
inputs: Retry policy with enabled, maxRetries, and baseDelayMs
Cancellation signal scoped to the structural operation
Scripted completion responses for success, transient failure, terminal failure, and abort
workflow_graph.entry_state: Context-summary preparation succeeds, but at least one generated summary path performs a single request whose transient failure terminates compaction or branch preservation.
workflow_graph.exit_state: All generated summary paths use the same bounded retry invariant, retain existing operation cancellation and supplied-summary behavior, expose retry lifecycle state, and satisfy recovery and terminal-case regression oracles.

steps.condition: A failed assistant response can be classified as transient or terminal and the caller can provide a retry policy.
steps.validation: Utility-level scripted responses prove bounded attempts, exponential-delay callbacks, fail-fast exclusions, successful recovery, and abortable backoff.

steps.condition: Execute only for model-generated summaries; bypass when a hook or extension already supplied the summary.
steps.validation: Entry-point tests prove compaction and branch-summary recovery after transient failures and unchanged failure behavior when retry is disabled, exhausted, aborted, or terminal.

steps.condition: The host exposes operation events or interactive status and retry delays are externally observable.
steps.validation: Subscriber tests verify operation-tagged scheduled/start/finished order; UI handlers restore the underlying compaction or branch-summary status and clear retry state on completion.

validation_ladder: Unit-test the retry primitive with immediate success, abort, terminal error, disabled policy, recovery, exhaustion, callback order, and cancellation during backoff.
Test each orchestration family with scripted assistant responses: context compaction and branch preservation must recover after transient failures and stop at the configured budget.
Run the issue regression scenario using a transient mid-stream "terminated" response and assert the summary is persisted only after recovery.
Verify observability: lifecycle events carry attempt counts, delays, errors, and operation context, while terminal errors emit no retry lifecycle.
Run the repository's required static check and the specific modified test files before considering the change complete.
stop_conditions: Stop and fail fast when the response is aborted or the classifier rejects the error as non-retryable.
Stop after maxRetries retry attempts and return the final error.
Stop retry waiting immediately when the operation abort signal fires.
Defer implementation if no stable summary-request boundary can receive both retry policy and cancellation signal.
Do not claim completion if any generated summary call site still bypasses the retry boundary unintentionally.
unresolved_or_deferred: The available evidence contains committed test code but no captured CI or local test execution result.
The shared retry helper documents exponential backoff but does not add jitter despite one comment mentioning delay before jitter.
Retry-finished payload detail is retained in internal callbacks but the higher-level summarization events expose only loop completion.

unresolved_questions: GitHub issue body, comments, reviews, and status checks were unavailable in the evidence bundle, so motivation and validation are grounded in the commit, implementation, documentation, and tests only.
No test command was run during this extraction; evidence establishes the committed validation oracle, not an independently observed passing run.
The pinned ref is a merge commit with a second parent, but the behavioral episode is defined by its recorded first-parent change from 4b91ec66fd33026e6e44a0dca5a954a59abd3ee9.
